offering_description.value: WisdomTree offers investment products and manages farmland investments. It provides onchain products, platforms and infrastructure for investors, institutions and developers.

quotes.quote: Discover products, platforms and infrastructure that support investors, institutions, developers and financial innovators across the onchain ecosystem.

Perry Vieth and Brandon Zick of Ceres Partners share the firm’s evolution into one of the leading farmland investment managers in the U.S. Now part of WisdomTree, Ceres continues its long-term focus on stewardship, value investing, and creating opportunity within the farmland asset class.
